prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Precise-object-edit. Edit target: HEARTHFALL flat wordmark reference. Keep all ten letters, their exact shapes and positions, flat brown fill, orange top-edge accents and pale blue bottom frost unchanged. Change ONLY flame on first A (third letter): remove current huge flame plume above A apex completely. Replace with a TINY flame INSIDE the triangular hole of that first A, rooted on the horizontal CROSSBAR forming bottom of that hole. Flame height should be 1/6 letter height, maximum, and remain mostly inside A counter. It must rise from CROSSBAR not apex. Do not draw flame anywhere above the A apex. Logo overall letter baseline and spelling HEARTHFALL remain identical. Transparent background.
rejected: First source had painterly woodgrain/bevels. Second flattened style correctly but oversized flame emerged from A apex. Third edit corrected a small flame on first A crossbar.
